lat.meaning: Latitude of the storm centre. It represents the north-south position of the storm, with negative values in the Southern Hemisphere and positive values in the Northern Hemisphere.

lon.meaning: Longitude of the storm centre. It represents the east-west position of the storm, measured in degrees east from 0° to 360° (for example, 280° is 80° W).

abs_lat.meaning: Absolute value of the storm-centre latitude, i.e. distance from the equator in either hemisphere. Higher values mean stronger Coriolis force, and usually cooler water and more shear.
